scorecard: max 7 dist.days, 3/3 sub MM50, follow-through recent
reconciliation: Semnale POZITIVE: Confirmare risc (VIX/credit/breadth pret), New Highs - New Lows.
Semnale NEGATIVE: Breadth participare (4/4 surse valide), Market timing (distribution days), Small-caps.
Market timing foloseste sesiuni EOD incheiate (mai proaspete ca breadth-ul) - cand semnaleaza vanzare, are prioritate ca avertisment timpuriu.
Conflictul in sine = incertitudine: redu marimea, nu paria puternic intr-o directie.
